experiment: STSP population Single/Multi under predeclared positive nonuniform surface densities

bandwidth_path.provenance: ratios fixed by the existing E6 formal STSP/DR design

circle_r2.label: S^1 subset R^2
circle_r2.query_rule: theta_j=2*pi*j/128, j=0,...,127; Clifford second phase fixed0 by retained symmetry

sphere2_r3.label: S^2 subset R^3
sphere2_r3.latent_rule: original Gauss-Jacobi latitude and signed-axis degree3 exact angular rule, rotated to current evaluation direction; linear density reweighting
sphere2_r3.query_rule: theta_j=pi*j/32, j=0,...,32; x=(cos(theta),sin(theta),0,...); retained axial symmetry

clifford_torus_r4.label: Clifford torus subset R^4
clifford_torus_r4.query_rule: theta_j=2*pi*j/128, j=0,...,127; Clifford second phase fixed0 by retained symmetry

sphere3_r4.label: S^3 subset R^4
sphere3_r4.latent_rule: original Gauss-Jacobi latitude and signed-axis degree3 exact angular rule, rotated to current evaluation direction; linear density reweighting
sphere3_r4.query_rule: theta_j=pi*j/32, j=0,...,32; x=(cos(theta),sin(theta),0,...); retained axial symmetry

sphere2_r10.label: S^2 subset R^10
sphere2_r10.latent_rule: original Gauss-Jacobi latitude and signed-axis degree3 exact angular rule, rotated to current evaluation direction; linear density reweighting
sphere2_r10.query_rule: theta_j=pi*j/32, j=0,...,32; x=(cos(theta),sin(theta),0,...); retained axial symmetry

corrugated_torus_r3.label: Corrugated torus subset R^3
corrugated_torus_r3.symmetry_reduction: rotational symmetry fixes u=0; v uses 128 equal-area mid-quantiles
corrugated_torus_r3.latent_rule: tensor midpoint rule in u and equal-area v quantiles
corrugated_torus_r3.query_rule: original128 equal-area meridian midquantiles, u=0; retained rotational symmetry

population_integration.tail_bound_description: latent nodes with distance/h beyond h/sigma+12 are omitted; the corresponding Gaussian displacement tail is bounded at the exp(-72) scale before dimension-polynomial factors

failure_policy: retain every declared cell and query; never crop sigma points or fitting windows

density.surface_measure: induced Riemannian area; not parameter-uniform density

scope_note: new density and the necessary symmetry-quotient query coverage only; original STSP residual/PCA/fiber/Newton/coefficient/quadrature controls retained; no MS-STSP or DR/YY rerun
